Method of Attack: Compromised update mechanism of Passwordstate to deliver info-stealing malware
Data theft malware designed to collect and exfiltrate system information and password data from Passwordstate database
Phishing emails replicating Click Studios correspondence to trick customers into downloading modified hotfix containing malware
Impacted Systems: Passwordstate customers who performed In-Place Upgrades between April 20 and April 22
Attack Vector: Phishing emails using social media shared legitimate emails to craft convincing messages
Malicious modified hotfix file (Moserware.zip) downloaded from a CDN network not controlled by Click Studios
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails mimicking Click Studios emails
Use of alternate site to obtain payload file
